claims.claim: Origen of Alexandria was an early Christian theologian and biblical scholar born around 185 in Alexandria, Egypt, and died around 254 in Tyre, Phoenicia.
He served as head of the Catechetical School of Alexandria, succeeding Clement of Alexandria under the authority of Bishop Demetrius.
Origen composed a biblical commentary titled Expositio in Proverbia (Exposition on Proverbs of Solomon).
These fragments have been edited and published in modern editions, for example in Migne’s Patrologia Graeca and in the Documenta Catholica Omnia PDF.
